item.title: Trump administration declines judge’s request to return college student who was deported over Thanksgiving break
item.description: A federal prosecutor in Massachusetts said Friday that the federal government will not return a 19-year-old college student who was deported over Thanksgiving despite a court order blocking her removal.

item.title: Venezuela frees several opposition members after lengthy politically motivated detentions
item.description: Venezuela’s government on Sunday released from prison several prominent opposition members, including one of the closest allies of Nobel Peace Prize laureate Maria Corina Machado, after lengthy politically motivated detentions.

item.title: US Olympians speaking up about politics at home face online backlash — including from Trump
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday said that it is hard to cheer for American Olympians who are speaking out against administration policies, calling one such critic “a real Loser” who perhaps should have stayed home.

item.title: The Brunswick County GOP hosts Candidate forum at Leland Cultural Arts Center
item.description: The Brunswick County GOP hosted a candidate forum on Saturday at the Leland Cultural Arts Center. The forum invited residents to meet and ask questions to the republican candidates.

item.title: Downtown District Day hopes to help businesses throughout each district
item.description: Downtown District Day gave free trolley services on Saturday to anybody who wanted to hop in and explore the many different districts in Wilmington.

item.description: The U.S. Coast guard is currently investigating the grounding of BHI ferry that happened on Thursday morning
